$comment: Justified, DATED suppressions for scripts/audit-deps.ts (the `Dependency audit` job).
This file suppresses SECURITY findings, so every entry carries a written reason and a
hard expiry. The gate fails on an EXPIRED entry (forcing re-review) AND on a STALE entry
matching no live advisory (so the list cannot rot into a blanket ignore).
Entries match on `ghsa` + `package` across BOTH lockfiles; `path` and `severity` are
documentation for the reviewer. FIX BY UPGRADING FIRST — only add an entry when no
in-range upgrade exists. Default floor is `high`: moderate/low are printed, not blocking.
